Unlike those chat/loop-dispatch families, TRIAGE-EMAIL is NOT chat/loop-projectable — it is invoked directly off the Communication enrichment path (CommunicationEnrichmentService.RunEmailTriageAsync via the ICommunicationTriageAi PublicContracts facade), so 'channel' is uniformly 'event' (the enrichment/event trigger, per the README's 3-channel vocabulary text|click|event) and 'utterance' is the event/affordance descriptor, not NL phrasing a user typed.
